title: Pesto eggs with spaghetti
summary: Soft scrambled eggs tossed with wholewheat spaghetti, a spoon of pesto and cherry tomatoes. Supper that uses one pan for the sauce and a pot for the pasta.

steps.instruction: Boil the kettle. Halve the tomatoes and beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Boil the spaghetti in the water with half the salt until tender, then drain, saving a splash of water.
Warm the oil and garlic, add the tomatoes for a minute, then pour in the eggs and stir until just set.
steps.tip: Take the eggs off while they still look slightly wet. They finish in the hot pasta.

steps.instruction: Toss the spaghetti, eggs, pesto and spinach with a splash of cooking water.
